# code-status-exploration

Repository: https://github.com/reblocke/code-status-exploration
Primary scholarly record: https://doi.org/10.1093/ajrccm/aamag162.1058
OUP abstract page: https://academic.oup.com/ajrccm/article/212/Supplement_1/aamag162.1058/8680759
Public poster: poster/code-status-exploration-ats-2026-poster.pdf

## Purpose

This repository supports a resident survey analysis about code-status discussions during ICU admission. It separates code-status verification, meaning confirmation and documentation of previously established goals of care, from code-status exploration, meaning shared decision-making about new or revised treatment preferences in the current clinical context.

## Citable Work

The current citable scholarly output is the ATS 2026 abstract:

Long CW, Langmann GA, Hirshberg EL, Locke BW. C56-19 Beyond Verification: Exploring Resident Attitudes and Behaviors in Code-Status Discussions. American Journal of Respiratory and Critical Care Medicine. 2026;212(Supplement_1). doi:10.1093/ajrccm/aamag162.1058.

No PMID, PMCID, journal article, or manuscript record exists for this repository as of this readiness pass.

## Data Boundary

The source Qualtrics workbook is restricted. It contains respondent metadata and free-text survey responses and must not be committed or published. Expected local path:

data/private/resident_code_status_survey.xlsx

The repository may contain only code, metadata, documentation, synthetic fixtures, aggregate summaries, and the sanitized poster PDF.

## Run Command

python scripts/analyze_code_status.py --input data/private/resident_code_status_survey.xlsx --output-dir outputs/analysis

Synthetic smoke command:

python scripts/analyze_code_status.py --input tests/fixtures/synthetic_qualtrics_export.xlsx --output-dir /tmp/code-status-smoke

## Important Files

- README.md: human-readable overview and reproduction guide.
- CITATION.cff: repository software citation plus ATS abstract citation.
- data_dictionary.md and data_dictionary.csv: source and derived variable documentation.
- scripts/analyze_code_status.py: canonical path-safe analysis script.
- ats_abstract_tables.ipynb: stripped optional notebook wrapper.
- tests/fixtures/synthetic_qualtrics_export.xlsx: no-respondent test fixture.
- poster/code-status-exploration-ats-2026-poster.pdf: flattened public poster.

## Future-Agent Cautions

- Do not add raw Qualtrics exports, response IDs, timestamps, free-text responses, profiling HTML, generated plot folders, or editable poster drafts.
- Do not copy full publisher abstract text into repository Markdown.
- Do not invent PMID, PMCID, journal article, manuscript submission, or acceptance metadata.
- Keep generated outputs under ignored outputs/ paths.
- Validate CITATION.cff and keep the data dictionary in sync with the analysis script when survey fields change.
